save-failed: Error when a cost pool, reading, price or sync request could not be saved.
categories.hardware: Each categories.*: the category of a cost pool (an admin's running cost of a self-hosted backend or subscription), in a badge and a select.
categories.power: Cost pool category: electricity a self-hosted backend uses.
categories.hosting: Cost pool category: what a host charges to run a self-hosted backend.
categories.subscription: Cost pool category: a model subscription (such as ChatGPT).
categories.other: Cost pool category: any other cost.
periods.hour: Each periods.*: an option of the cost pool form's Per select (the amount is per hour, day, month or year). Lowercase.
periods.day: Option of the cost pool form's Per select: the amount is per day. Lowercase.
periods.month: Option of the cost pool form's Per select: the amount is per month. Lowercase.
periods.year: Option of the cost pool form's Per select: the amount is per year. Lowercase.
sources.admin: Each sources.*: where a model price came from, in the Prices table's Source column and the price sync table. "Admin": an admin entered it. The others are names of public price lists; keep product names (OpenRouter, DeepInfra, Azure, AWS, Bedrock, models.dev, LiteLLM) as they are.
sources.openrouter: Name of a public price list; keep as is.
sources.deepinfra: Name of a public price list; keep as is.
sources.azure: Name of Microsoft Azure's public price list; keep the product names.
sources.aws: Name of Amazon's public price list for Bedrock models; keep the product names.
sources.models.dev: Name of a community price list; keep as is.
sources.litellm: Name of a community price list; keep LiteLLM as is.
actions: Hidden column heading for screen readers, over a table's row buttons.
remove: Button in a table row: removes that cost pool, reading or price.
pools.title: Card heading on Operations → Cost: running costs of self-hosted backends and subscriptions.
pools.description: "Turns": answers from a socio (an AI agent). "Idle capacity": cost in hours without turns.
pools.pool: Column heading: the cost pool's name, category and terms.
pools.cost: Column heading: what the pool cost over the range, in US dollars.
pools.took: Column heading: the part of a pool's cost the turns used.
pools.idle: Column heading: the part of a pool's cost in hours without turns.
pools.estimate: Badge on a subscription pool: its cost per turn is an estimate.
pools.gpu: Badge on a pool shared by GPU time, which nothing measures yet.
pools.no-backends: In a pool's row, when it pays for no backend; lowercase.
pools.terms.variable: What a metered pool costs: {{amount}} is US dollars per unit (a kWh, for one).
pools.terms.depreciated: What a purchase costs: {{amount}} in US dollars, written off over a number of months.
pools.terms.per: What a running cost pool costs: {{amount}} in US dollars per hour, day, month or year.
pools.readings: Button: shows a metered pool's meter readings.
pools.edit: Button in a cost pool's row: opens the form to change it.
pools.removed: Toast after a cost pool was removed.
pools.none: In place of the Cost pools table on Operations → Cost when an admin has added none yet. ChatGPT is a product name; keep it.
pools.add: Button: opens the form for a new cost pool.
pool-form.change: Heading of the form that changes a cost pool; {{name}} is its name.
pool-form.new: Heading of the form that adds a cost pool.
pool-form.name: Label of the field for the cost pool's name.
pool-form.category: Label of the select of the cost pool's category (categories.*).
pool-form.metered: Checkbox label: the pool's cost comes from meter readings.
pool-form.amount: Label of the amount field, by kind of pool: running cost, metered (per unit) or purchase.
pool-form.per: Label of the select of the period the amount is for.
pool-form.months: Label: over how many months a purchase is written off.
pool-form.from: Label of the date the pool's cost starts, in UTC.
pool-form.until: Label of the date the pool's cost ends, in UTC; left empty while it still runs.
pool-form.backends: Heading of the checkboxes of backends (where models run) the pool pays for.
pool-form.no-backends: "Platform": an admins' page of Settings where backends are added.
pool-form.weights: Heading of the fields that say how much each kind of token counts when an hour's cost is shared among turns.
pool-form.input: Under the token weights heading: how much an input token counts.
pool-form.cached: Under the token weights heading: how much a cached input token counts.
pool-form.output: Under the token weights heading: how much an output token counts.
pool-form.save: Button: saves the changes to a cost pool.
pool-form.add: Button: adds the new cost pool.
pool-form.cancel: Button: closes the cost pool form without saving.
pool-form.saved: Toast after a cost pool was changed.
pool-form.added: Toast after a cost pool was added.
readings.title: Heading; {{name}} is the cost pool's name.
readings.description: Description under a metered cost pool's meter readings heading: how each reading's usage is spread over the time since the previous reading.
readings.reading: One meter reading: {{quantity}} used, {{measure}} the unit as the admin typed it (kWh), {{price}} in US dollars per unit.
readings.removed: Toast after a meter reading was removed.
readings.added: Toast after a meter reading was added.
readings.read-on: Label of the date field of a new meter reading.
readings.used: Label of the quantity field of a new meter reading.
readings.unit: Label of the unit field of a new meter reading (such as kWh).
readings.unit-price: Label of the price per unit of a new meter reading; empty uses the pool's amount.
sync.title: Card heading: the daily reading of public model price lists.
sync.on: Card description while the daily price sync is on; a link to Settings follows. "Socio" is the product's name.
sync.off: Card description while the daily price sync is off; a link to Settings follows.
sync.switch: Link to Operations → Settings, where the price sync is switched on or off.
sync.list: Column heading: a public price list.
sync.last-read: Column heading: when the price list was last read.
sync.kept: Column heading: how many of the list's models Socio kept the prices of.
sync.failed: Badge when the last read of a price list failed; {{error}} is the error text, not translated.
sync.never: In the Last read column for a list never read.
sync.matched: How many models were kept ({{matched}}) of those the list had ({{fetched}}).
sync.syncing: Text of the Sync now button while a sync runs.
sync.now: Button: reads the price lists right away.
sync.next: When the next sync runs; {{when}} is a date and time.
prices.title: Card heading: the table of model prices per million tokens.
prices.description: "Provider *": the asterisk is typed as the provider to mean any provider; keep it.
prices.find: Label of the search field that filters the prices table.
prices.provider: Column heading: the provider the price is for (* means any).
prices.input: Column heading: the price of input tokens.
prices.cached: Column heading: the price of cached input tokens.
prices.output: Column heading: the price of output tokens.
prices.from: Column heading: the date a price holds from.
prices.source: Column heading: where the price came from (sources.*).
prices.removed: Toast after an admin's price was removed.
prices.no-match: In place of the prices table when the search matches nothing.
prices.none: In place of the Prices table when there are no model prices yet. "Price sync" is the card above that reads public price lists daily; keep the same words.
price-form.title: Heading of the form where an admin adds a model price.
price-form.model: Label of the field for the model's id.
price-form.provider: Label: the provider's id; typing * means any provider.
price-form.from: Label of the date the price holds from, in UTC.
price-form.input: Label: US dollars per million input tokens.
price-form.cached: Label: US dollars per million cached input tokens; can be left empty.
price-form.output: Label: US dollars per million output tokens.
price-form.saved: Toast after a price was saved.
